one_liner: Otter.ai has a REST public API with self-generated bearer API keys, but it's Enterprise-only and requires account-manager enablement; an official OAuth MCP server exists (mcp.otter.ai).
auth_notes: Public API uses bearer API keys created at Integrations → Developer (2 per user). The MCP server uses OAuth but is not a developer-registerable OAuth API; the connect.tryotter.com OAuth docs belong to a different product (Otter restaurant/delivery platform) and were not counted.
access_notes: Public API is for Enterprise workspaces only; Enterprise is sold via contact sales (100-user minimum) and must be enabled via an account manager. Free Basic plan does not include the API.
blocker_notes: API access requires an Enterprise plan (contact sales) and enablement by an Otter account manager. The official MCP server is OAuth-based and read-only (3 tools), but it is not a general developer API.

evidence.quote: All API requests require authentication using Bearer token authentication. Follow the steps below to create your **API key.**
Otter's Public API is available for all Enterprise workspaces. If you do not see this feature for your workspace, contact your Otter account manager.
SSO and SCIM are only available on Enterprise (100-user minimum license); they are not on Basic, Pro, or Business.
